rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a grammatical tense as a time-reference system or as a verb form such as the past tense.

example.english: This sentence needs to use the past tense.
example.jyutping: ne1 geoi3 jiu3 jung6 gwo3 heoi3 si4 taai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling stressed, anxious, or not relaxed.

example.english: I was really tense during my first job interview.
example.traditional: 我第一次見工嗰陣真係好緊張。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 gung1 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this for something physically pulled taut, rather than for a person's emotional tension.

example.english: The rubber band is already taut and tense, so don’t pull it any further.
example.traditional: 條橡筋已經繃緊喇，唔好再拉。
example.jyutping: tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 ji5 ging1 maang1 gan2 laa3 m4 hou2 zoi3 laai1
